fileChanges: JustTonesWatch/WatchContentView.swift — restructure the compact primary surface; add pushed profile and pitch selection plus a focused sound-controls destination; keep all Watch interaction local.

JustTonesWatch/JustTonesWatchApp.swift — expose or preserve only the local playback-host state and click-free selection behavior necessary for truthful Watch presentation; do not alter the render-path safety rules.
JustTonesWatch/Localizable.xcstrings — localize visible and accessibility labels, playback states, level-adjustment instructions, values, and non-SPL explanation.

JustTonesWatchTests/JustTonesWatchTests.swift — add deterministic local playback and selection transition coverage; add a Watch UI-test target only if the project requires one to automate the specified surface behavior.
notes: This plan is planning-only and does not activate SP-030 or authorize implementation.
SP-031 retains interruption/resume, route disclosure, disconnected-data, synchronization, failure, and unavailable-state presentation beyond what is already required to keep this surface truthful.
No iPhone remote-control behavior, profile or tuning-system authoring on Watch, network service, account, analytics, background-mode, or new dependency is in scope.
scope: Restructure WatchContentView into the compact local primary surface: profile entry, selected pitch and locale-formatted frequency, host-confirmed local playback state, Previous, prominent text-labeled Play/Stop, Next, and Sound controls. Do not retain passive timbre/route/level summaries or mutable output controls in the primary scrolling surface.

Push locally available profile selection and ordered pitch browsing into secondary destinations. Stopped pitch selection stays silent; active previous, next, or pitch selection uses the existing local click-free transition. A profile change stops local Watch playback before selection changes and requires an explicit new Play.

Provide a focused Sound controls destination with exactly a value-bearing supported-timbre selector and output-level control. Crown rotation may change level only after deliberate Level adjustment focus; Back, Done, dismissal, or losing row focus exits that mode. Level changes remain bounded, announce once, and never begin playback.

Keep profile and tuning-system creation, editing, import, export, conflict resolution, hiding, restoration, and deletion iPhone-only. Preserve independent Watch selection, output, route, and playback state; an action on one device must not automatically start or stop the other.

Add focused automated coverage for JT-TEST-070 through JT-TEST-075 and JT-TEST-081 where technically practical, including deterministic host/view-model assertions for state transitions that Watch UI automation cannot observe. Qualify VoiceOver order, compact/large text layout, localized values, paired simulation, and physical Watch Crown/listening behavior separately.
summary: Implement the EP-018 compact, independently playable Watch tone surface with safe focused sound controls and an iPhone-only administration boundary, while leaving Watch data-status and extended lifecycle presentation to SP-031.
title: SP-030 Watch interaction surface plan
verificationCriteria: JT-TEST-070 through JT-TEST-075 demonstrate independent local Watch playback, the compact primary controls, silent stopped selection, click-free active selection, safe profile changes, deliberate Crown-only level adjustment, and independent iPhone/Watch sessions.
JT-TEST-081 demonstrates that Watch exposes local selection and playback only, with all profile and tuning-system administration remaining on iPhone.

Paired-simulator evidence and physical-Watch listening, Crown, VoiceOver, Dynamic Type, localization, and route observations are recorded independently; a build or simulator pass alone is not physical-device acceptance.
